about_the_game:
BEACH BAR SIMULATOR – DESIGN, SERVE, SHINE!

How about preparing coffee, cocktails, and delicious snacks while watching the sunset in Beach Bar Simulator?
You run a cozy and narrow bar set right by the Miami coastline. Customers seeking relief from the heat keep coming in one after another, orders are piling up fast, and you’re racing against time in a limited space.
Will you manage alone, or team up with friends? This summer spot’s survival is in your hands!

SOLO OR TEAMPLAY: EXPERIENCE CO-OP FUN AT ITS PEAK!

Beach Bar Simulator is way more than a classic management game.
It’s real-time, fast-paced, and incredibly fun!

🔹 Build and develop your bar from scratch in single-player mode,
🔹 Or in co-op mode, team up with 2-8 players to keep up with the orders.

One of you handles espresso machines, another works the blender, while someone else manages the fryer...
Coordination is key because the number of customers increases and time is your biggest rival.

A SEASIDE BAR WITH CONSTANTLY EVOLVING CHALLENGES

Your bar starts on a platform surrounded by the sea, and over time you expand the space into a bigger venue.
Every move and service counts; your space grows but so do the challenges!

  • Offer refreshing drinks and snacks during the day,

  • Manage the lively crowd with live music and happy hour in the evening,

  • And keep up with the rush of orders during the wild party nights!

Key Features

  • Single & Co-op Modes (2-8 Players) – Enjoy a fun and fast-paced multiplayer experience that builds team spirit!

  • Extensive Menu – From coffee varieties to tropical cocktails, plus tasty treats like hamburgers and hot dogs.

  • Expansion & Customization – Start with a small bar and turn it into a bigger, personalized venue.

  • Strategic Placement & Time Management – Position your machines smartly, use your time efficiently, and boost your service speed.

  • Customer Satisfaction & Reputation – Increase customer happiness with fast, accurate service and raise your social media ratings.

  • Dynamic Feedback – Track customer reactions, improve your service quality, and optimize your menu.

  • Fun Events & Chaotic Moments – Experience surprises like happy hour madness, power outages, and special customer requests!

In short:

Beach Bar Simulator offers a unique, fast-paced, cooperative management experience in a growing seaside bar.
Work with your friends, keep up with the orders, and enjoy an unforgettable night full of laughter!

content_descriptors.notes: Beach Bar Simulator contains themes of alcohol and social interactions. The game may feature some adult-oriented themes, but does not contain explicit sexual content, excessive violence, or drug use. Players will engage with bar management, customer relationships, and social interactions

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 @ 3,3 GHz (4 CPUs)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1050
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 @ 3,2 GHz (4 CPUs)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1060

short_description: Run your own beach bar on the shores of Miami Beach! Serve drinks, manage customers, and grow your business. Play solo or co-op, customize your bar, and create the ultimate summer hotspot! 🍹🏝️
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Polish
